path.id: Make the response as visible as the report.
Residents may see potholes, broken paths, or neglected spaces but not know where to report. Unclear responsibility and few updates leave them unsure if complaints lead to action.
Category, photo and location capture the issue. An issue page and timeline make progress inspectable; the local feed lets others support an existing report.
